ruleDefinitions.name: Guest Users Invited To Tenant By Non Approved Inviters
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects guest users being invited to tenant by non-approved inviters Note: Unmapped fields: Category, OperationName, InitiatedBy

sequences.query: (Category = "UserManagement" AND OperationName = "Invite\ external\ user") AND  NOT (InitiatedBy = RGX(".*\\<approved\\ guest\\ inviter\\ use\\ OR\\ for\\ multiple\\>.*"))
